evidence.observation: The first viewport names Jamie, the target technical-project and product-operations work, and the concrete operating structures he creates.
The page maps delivery coordination, risk surfacing, documentation, launch support, and handoffs to named project evidence.
Jamie's attributed planning and presenter roles remain distinct from the Board recommendation and Council actions, and the page explicitly distinguishes appropriation from receipt or expenditure.
The event, Council attribution, independent follow-on, press coverage, and archived status resolve to bounded public claims with local references and backlinks.
The index is orderly but long: each card repeats summary, unclear-to-usable framing, role fit, tags, and status before the reader reaches the case study.

Jamie is visible as co-founder, project manager, co-lead, and presenter, while the $490,539 Council appropriation is stated directly and right-sized; the unexplained CCED acronym keeps the page from exceptional one-pass clarity.
The page directly says Jamie built the independent prototype and translated constituent-services data into issue pathways and resident-facing guidance without claiming official Council ownership.
Jamie's documentation, web-infrastructure, organizing, and policy-translation contributions are visible while coalition and legislative outcomes retain collective and institutional credit.
The artifact gallery consists of descriptive text surfaces rather than approved screenshots or project imagery; this remains an allowed application-profile deferral.
The deterministic resume-consistency gate passes, including chronology and agreement between the approved resume and public site.

Candidate-bound evidence reports no overflow, working citation navigation, and visible focus for all traversed controls, but the 200 percent check used an equivalent reflow viewport rather than browser-chrome zoom.
Canonical, Open Graph, and Twitter metadata are present, but the inspected candidate still uses staging metadata defaults rather than verified production sharing behavior.
The repository defines standalone and Docker operation plus a health route, while matching deployed-SHA, production smoke, indexing, and rollback evidence remain deferred for this profile.
